about: Shots for tests/test_fire_control_calibration.py, written by scripts/fire_control_calibration.py fixture. class is the target's maneuver class at fire time; n is how many ships had fired at it in the last 30 s (harness: the shooter count); dodge (its evasion throttle, null = does not dodge), jink (missed jink burn, m/s^2 across the line of fire) and pending / pending_in (unlit HEADING burn, m/s^2, s) are the forecast's TargetMotion inputs; p_conv is the engine's conversion (dispersion-roll) probability; hit is the engine outcome.
